snippet.title: LETICULUS - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
👉 Steam-Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5294030/Leticulus/

Wishlist LETICULUS now and don't miss out on future announcements and the demo release!

Beyond time. Beyond space. There lies the unknown.

LETICULUS is a retro roguelite exploration shooter in which you venture into a strange and mysterious world. Each run is different and every discovery could change your fate.

Choose your pilot and set out on an adventure filled with hidden secrets and dangerous enemies, while building a ship that looks and plays your way. Mix and match ship parts to create radically different designs, abilities and weapons, with over a billion possible combinations to discover.

Unlock new ships, pilots, and items with every run, while you push deeper toward the mysterious summit… and discover what awaits you at the top.

------------------------------

Admire the breathtaking pixel art, listen to the chiptune beats, and dive deeper into the world of Leticulus. A game developed by Stefan K. Heider.

#pixelart #retrogaming #indiegame  #indiegames #gamedev #indiegamedev #Steam #wishlist
